dedupe_keys.name: model for a high temporal resolution residential building occupancy model to generate high temporal resolution heating load profiles of occupancy integrated archetypes

description: This model is published by Mendeley. It describes a stochastic building-occupancy model using Markov-chain methods to generate heating-load inputs. Coverage is national within GB. Spatial resolution is not established here. The data period and sampling interval are not fully established. Access is through the public metadata page and its provider links. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Cost is uncertain; the on_request value flags the need to obtain terms, not a verified price or provider requirement. The model uses occupancy categories derived from the UK Time Use Survey 2015. Transfer to other populations requires justification. This review identifies optimisation, capacity planning as potential simulation uses, subject to the stated limits. Related catalogue records are model-energyplus. These are contextual links; no unverified interoperability or actual use is claimed.
